segments.title: A monkey NOBODY knew existed
segments.sub: Spotted on a **rope bridge** over a road
segments.say: Scientists found a monkey nobody knew existed, on cameras at rope bridges over roads in Brazil.

segments.title: Hiding in camera photos
segments.say: It turned up in thousands of camera-trap photos of animals crossing the bridges.

segments.title: Its own species for 500,000+ years
segments.sub: Its DNA says **half a million years** apart
segments.say: Its DNA says it's been its own species for more than half a million years.

segments.title: Howlers are LOUD
segments.say: And howler monkeys are loud. Their calls top a hundred decibels, and carry for miles.

segments.title: Maybe already endangered
segments.sub: Its forest is being **cut down fast**
segments.say: One of the scientists thinks it may already be endangered, because its forest is vanishing fast.
